note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 9117 Section 4.2 ('BGP Flow Specification implementations MUST enforce that the AS in the left-most position of the AS_PATH attribute of a Flow Specification route received via the External Border Gateway Protocol (eBGP) matches the AS in the left-most position of the AS_PATH attribute of the best-match unicast route for the destination prefix embedded in the Flow Specification NLRI.'). Verified rib_flowspec_validation.go::flowSpecASPath extracts leftmost AS_SEQUENCE ASN (0 for AS_SET) and flowSpecAuthorized enforces flow.firstAS != 0 && flow.firstAS == best.firstAS on external non-local-domain routes. TestRFC9117AuthorizationUsesLongestCoveringRoute holds originator equal to the /16 best-match route and varies only leftmost AS on an eBGP route-server peer (65002 installs; 65001 matching only /8 stays ineligible). TestFlowSpecAuthorizationFromReceivedUpdates proves eBGP route-server authorization on matching leftmost AS 65001 and rejects mismatched leftmost AS 65002 and AS_SET-only paths. Q1-Q4 pass.
